properties.notes: This land is now disused but had previously be utilised as a haulage depot, comprising a garage building and hardstanding. Highlighted for potential redevelopment along with the adjacent site (9121, 9122). Across the two parcels, the existing dwelling and haulage garage are earmarked for demolition. An initial application was refused for 7 homes after clearance (17/04396/FUL). A revised proposed construction of 5 homes has now been permitted (19/01224/FUL). The approved scheme is for 2 dormer bungalows and 3 townhouses. Development yet to commence but forecast for completion within the next 5 years.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
